verdict.rationale: Microsoft provides official SDKs/tooling (Agents Toolkit CLI, Microsoft Graph API with live, documented OData schema, Bot Framework/Teams platform docs) enabling programmatic and AI-agent development against Teams, confirmed by a working Graph $metadata endpoint and CLI docs. However, community feedback notes API integration is heavier/more complex than competitors (requiring full Azure/Graph stack vs simple webhooks), and llms.txt/openapi discovery probes failed, suggesting less AI-native-friendly documentation surface.
